scope: Read-only portability/semantic review and two bounded synthetic byte-integrity fixtures. No original archives, source workbooks, material models or material CLI executed.
static_review: SHA256 uses1MiB streaming chunks and does not call hashlib.file_digest.
Source parses with Python3.10 grammar; this is not a claim of separate Python3.10 interpreter execution.
Default package root is the script parent: suitable when copied to package root; from repository tools/ use explicit --package-root to an actual resource package.
Current payload entries always checked. Existing history entries always checked. Missing history allowed by default and rejected by --require-history.
Counts distinguish history present/declared and whether strict history was required.
Member paths reject absolute/parent traversal/Windows separator/colon and resolved paths outside root.
Hash-only checker does not claim ZIP parsing or scientific validation.
No model/data import, download, installation or mutation of package payload.
parent_existing_tests_not_recounted: Root PORTABILITY_FIX_CHECK.json separately records no-file_digest simulation, missing required history and changed payload tests.
projection_note: Local-machine locators only are redacted where present; original audit bytes remain in the local resource archive.
